name: eliviz
tagline_zh: 扔进CSV、Excel、SQLite或日志，自动生成带3D动画和滚动特效的HTML报告。图表、表格、时间线全都有。
tagline_en: Drop in CSV, Excel, SQLite, or logs; get a stunning single-file HTML report with 3D hero, scroll effects, charts.
desc_en: Parse data files of many formats — CSV/TSV, Excel (.xlsx), SQLite, JSONL/NDJSON, JSON, Markdown, plain text, and log files — and generate a stunning, self-contained, single-file HTML experience that visualizes the data: a Three.js animated hero, GSAP scroll animations, Tailwind styling, column-profiled data tables with search/sort/pagination, histograms and time-series charts, a markdown reading v
why_zh: 不只是画图表，它把数据变成可交互的叙事页面，且所有依赖打包在一个HTML里，分享零门槛。
why_en: It turns raw data into an interactive story in one self-contained HTML file—no dependencies, no setup, just share.
